# AppointPanda

> Find a dentist in Dubai: a directory of Dubai dental clinics with online appointment requests, plus independent guides to dental treatment in the UAE. Other emirates are coming soon. Guide prices are indicative AED ranges, not quotes. Clinic ratings come from Google and are shown as reported.

Content last reviewed: 2026-10-21. Editorial policy: https://www.appointpanda.ae/editorial-policy/

## Dubai (primary market)
- [Dentists in Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/): licensing (DHA, or the Dubai Healthcare City Authority inside Healthcare City), insurance and areas.
- [Find a dentist in Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/find-clinics/): search by area, reason for visit, treatment or insurance; patients request an appointment and the clinic confirms the time.
- [Dentists in Dubai Marina](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-marina/): A dense waterfront district of residential towers where most clinics sit on the ground or podium floors of buildings, many open into the evening.
- [Dentists in JBR (Jumeirah Beach Residence)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/jumeirah-beach-residence/): The beachfront strip next to the Marina, with clinics along The Walk and in the residential towers behind it.
- [Dentists in Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/jlt/): Clusters of office and residential towers around artificial lakes, with clinics in the podiums that suit people who work in the area.
- [Dentists in Palm Jumeirah](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/palm-jumeirah/): The palm-shaped island has clinics in its malls and along the trunk, serving residents and hotel guests.
- [Dentists in Downtown Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/downtown-dubai/): The area around the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, where clinics are aimed at residents of the towers and people working nearby.
- [Dentists in Business Bay](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/business-bay/): An office and residential district along the Dubai Canal, with clinics that keep office-friendly hours.
- [Dentists in DIFC](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/difc/): Dubai's financial district, where clinics serve a mainly professional, weekday population.
- [Dentists in Jumeirah](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/jumeirah/): A long coastal residential area of villas, where many clinics are in converted villas along Jumeirah Beach Road and Al Wasl Road.
- [Dentists in Umm Suqeim](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/umm-suqeim/): A villa neighbourhood south of Jumeirah, near the Burj Al Arab, with family-oriented clinics.
- [Dentists in Al Barsha](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-barsha/): A large mixed area around the Mall of the Emirates, with clinics in medical centres, malls and residential buildings.
- [Dentists in Al Quoz](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-quoz/): A mixed industrial and residential area between Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, with clinics serving workers and nearby residents.
- [Dentists in Motor City](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/motor-city/): A residential community inland, near Dubai Autodrome, with clinics in its local shopping areas.
- [Dentists in Arabian Ranches](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/arabian-ranches/): A large villa community where clinics sit in the community centres and serve mostly families.
- [Dentists in Dubai Hills](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-hills/): A newer community between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, with clinics in Dubai Hills Mall and local centres.
- [Dentists in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/jvc/): A busy residential community of mid-rise buildings and townhouses with neighbourhood clinics.
- [Dentists in Dubai Sports City](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-sports-city/): A residential area next to Motor City, with clinics in its apartment buildings.
- [Dentists in Bur Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/bur-dubai/): One of Dubai's oldest districts, on the western side of the Creek, with many long-established clinics.
- [Dentists in Karama](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/karama/): A busy residential and shopping district next to Bur Dubai, known for good-value clinics.
- [Dentists in Oud Metha](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/oud-metha/): A central district between Karama and Dubai Healthcare City, with hospitals and medical centres.
- [Dentists in Dubai Healthcare City](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/healthcare-city/): A healthcare free zone with hospitals and specialist clinics, regulated by the Dubai Healthcare City Authority rather than the DHA.
- [Dentists in Deira](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/deira/): The historic commercial district east of the Creek, with a large number of clinics and medical centres.
- [Dentists in Al Qusais](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-qusais/): A residential area near the Sharjah border, with neighbourhood clinics serving families and commuters.
- [Dentists in Al Nahda (Dubai)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-nahda-dubai/): A residential area on the Dubai side of the Sharjah border, with clinics in its apartment blocks.
- [Dentists in Mirdif](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/mirdif/): A family suburb near the airport, with clinics in villas, medical centres and Mirdif City Centre.
- [Dentists in Al Warqa](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-warqa/): A residential area south of Mirdif, with neighbourhood clinics serving families.
- [Dentists in Dubai Silicon Oasis](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-silicon-oasis/): A technology park and residential community on the Al Ain Road, with clinics serving residents and workers.
- [Dentists in International City](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/international-city/): A large, affordable residential area on the eastern edge of the city, with clinics in its country-themed clusters.
- [Dentists in Al Safa](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-safa/): A residential area between Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, with clinics in villas and small medical centres.
- [Dentists in Dubai Investment Park](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-investment-park/): A large mixed industrial and residential district off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, with clinics serving residents and workers.
- [Dentists in Discovery Gardens](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/discovery-gardens/): A residential community of themed low-rise buildings near Ibn Battuta, with neighbourhood clinics.
- [Dentists in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/jvt/): A villa and townhouse community next to JVC, with a small number of local clinics.
- [Dentists in Al Mamzar](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-mamzar/): A coastal residential area at the northern tip of Deira, next to the Sharjah border.
- [Dentists in Al Rashidiya](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/al-rashidiya/): A residential area near Dubai International Airport, at the eastern end of the Red Line.
- [Dentists in Dubai Festival City](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/dubai-festival-city/): A waterfront mixed-use district on the Creek, near Al Garhoud, with clinics around Festival City Mall.

## Reasons for a dental visit (Dubai)
- [Toothache](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/toothache/): Toothache that lasts more than a day or two, keeps you awake or comes with swelling needs a dentist soon, because it often means infection or a deep cavity.
- [Chipped or broken tooth](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/broken-tooth/): A chipped or broken tooth should be seen within a few days, sooner if it hurts or has a sharp edge, so the dentist can protect it before it cracks further.
- [Swollen face or gum](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/swelling/): Swelling from a tooth is a sign of infection and should be seen the same day. Swelling that spreads towards the eye or neck, or affects breathing or swallowing, needs a hospital emergency department.
- [Check-up and cleaning](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/checkup-and-cleaning/): Most adults benefit from a check-up and professional cleaning every six months; it is the visit that catches problems while they are small.
- [Bleeding gums](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/bleeding-gums/): Gums that bleed when you brush are usually an early sign of gum disease, which a professional cleaning and better daily care can often reverse.
- [Missing tooth](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/missing-tooth/): Replacing a missing tooth stops neighbouring teeth drifting into the gap; implants, bridges and dentures are the main options.
- [Crooked or gappy teeth](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/crooked-teeth/): Crowding, gaps and bite problems are treated with braces or clear aligners, after an orthodontic assessment with X-rays and a scan.
- [Stained or yellow teeth](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/stained-teeth/): Surface stains often lift with a professional cleaning; deeper yellowing responds to whitening, and stains that do not may need veneers.
- [Smile makeover](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/smile-makeover/): A smile makeover is planned around a consultation, photos and a mock-up; good clinics suggest the least invasive option that meets your goal.
- [Wisdom tooth pain](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/wisdom-tooth-pain/): Pain and swelling around a back tooth that is coming through is often an infected wisdom tooth; it usually settles with cleaning and treatment, and some teeth need removing.
- [Child's first visit](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/childs-first-visit/): Children should see a dentist when their first tooth appears or by their first birthday; early visits are short and mostly about getting comfortable.
- [Nervous about the dentist](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/reasons/dental-anxiety/): If you are anxious, tell the clinic when you book; many dentists offer longer appointments, breaks and, for some treatments, sedation.

## Treatment guides
- [Dental Implants](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/dental-implants/): A dental implant is a small titanium or zirconia post placed in the jawbone to replace a missing tooth root, topped with a crown that looks and works like a natural tooth.
- [Invisalign & Clear Aligners](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/invisalign/): Invisalign is a brand of clear, removable aligners that move teeth gradually using a series of custom trays, each worn for about 22 hours a day.
- [Braces](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/braces/): Braces are fixed brackets and wires that apply steady pressure to move teeth and correct the bite, suitable for children, teens and adults.
- [Veneers](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/veneers/): Veneers are thin shells of porcelain or composite bonded to the front of teeth to change their colour, shape or size.
- [Hollywood Smile](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/hollywood-smile/): A "Hollywood smile" is a full smile makeover, usually veneers or crowns on most visible upper and lower teeth, planned to give an even, bright result.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/teeth-whitening/): Professional teeth whitening uses a peroxide gel, applied in the clinic or with custom home trays, to lighten the natural colour of teeth by several shades.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/root-canal/): Root canal treatment removes infected or inflamed pulp from inside a tooth, cleans and seals the canals, and lets you keep the tooth instead of extracting it.
- [Teeth Cleaning (Scale & Polish)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/teeth-cleaning/): A professional scale and polish removes hardened plaque (tartar) and surface stains that brushing cannot shift, helping prevent gum disease and decay.
- [Emergency Dentist](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/emergency-dentist/): An emergency dentist treats urgent problems such as severe toothache, swelling, a knocked-out tooth or a broken tooth, usually the same day.
- [Children's Dentistry](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/pediatric-dentistry/): Pediatric dentistry is dental care for babies, children and teens, focused on prevention, gentle treatment and keeping young patients comfortable.
- [Wisdom Tooth Removal](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/wisdom-tooth-removal/): Wisdom tooth removal is the extraction of one or more third molars, usually because they are impacted, infected or damaging neighbouring teeth.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/dental-crowns/): A dental crown is a custom cap that covers a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its shape, strength and appearance.

## Dentists by emirate
- [Dentists in Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/): Dubai has the largest choice of private dental clinics in the UAE, from neighbourhood practices to specialist centres, licensed by the Dubai Health Authority or, inside Dubai Healthcare City, by its own regulator. Licensing: Dubai Health Authority (DHA).
- Coming soon (not live yet; information only, no appointment requests): Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain.
